tool_input.command: ls -la && echo "---DATA---" && ls -la data/ && echo "---HEAD---" && head -5 data/features.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/features.csv
echo "HOST=$HOPSWORKS_HOST" && echo "KEY_SET=${HOPSWORKS_API_KEY:+yes}" && hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
cat data/schema.md && echo "---TAIL---" && tail -3 data/features.csv && echo "---DATES---" && cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | head -50
hops fg --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops fg stats --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -40
hops context 2>&1 | head -40
hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo "===FGLIST==="; hops fg list --json 2>&1 | head -40

hops fg create drift_features \
  --primary-key entity_id,event_time \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "entity_id:string,event_time:timestamp,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double" \
  --description "Daily feature observations for drift detection" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert drift_features --file data/features.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Insert CSV data into feature group

tool_input.command:
hops fg delete drift_features --version 1 --json 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "===RECREATE==="
hops fg create drift_features \
  --primary-key entity_id,event_time \
  --features "entity_id:string,event_time:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double" \
  --description "Daily feature observations for drift detection" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Recreate FG with event_time as string

tool_input.command: hops fg insert drift_features --file data/features.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops sql "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) AS d, count(*) c FROM drift_features GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops sql --no-verify "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) AS d, count(*) c FROM drift_features GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -20
hops trino --help 2>&1 | tail -20
hops trino catalogs --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -20
for cat in hudi hive delta; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops trino tables "$cat.mlpab3eab43" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -i drift; done
for cat in hudi hive delta iceberg; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops trino tables "$cat.mlpab3eab43" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -15; done
tool_input.description: list tables in each catalog schema

tool_input.command: hops job list --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -30
hops fg preview drift_features --version 1 --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -30
for cat in hive hudi delta; do echo "=== schemas in $cat ==="; hops trino schemas "$cat" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -iE "mlpab|drift|2227|featurestore" ; done
for cat in hive hudi delta; do echo "=== $cat.mlpab3eab43_featurestore ==="; hops trino tables "$cat.mlpab3eab43_featurestore" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -i drift; done
tool_input.description: find drift table in featurestore schema

tool_input.command: hops trino query "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) d, count(*) c, round(avg(f1),3) m1, round(avg(f2),3) m2, round(avg(f3),3) m3, round(avg(f4),3) m4, round(avg(f5),3) m5, round(avg(f6),3) m6 FROM hive.mlpab3eab43_featurestore.drift_features_1 GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -100

hops trino query "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) d, count(*) c, round(avg(f1),3) m1, round(avg(f2),3) m2, round(avg(f3),3) m3, round(avg(f4),3) m4, round(avg(f5),3) m5, round(avg(f6),3) m6 FROM delta.mlpab3eab43_featurestore.drift_features_1 GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -vE "UserWarning|compatib|pip install|Logged in|^$"

hops trino query "SELECT substr(event_time,1,10) d, round(avg(f3),3) mean_f3, round(stddev(f3),3) std_f3, round(min(f3),2) mn, round(max(f3),2) mx FROM delta.mlpab3eab43_featurestore.drift_features_1 WHERE substr(event_time,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-13' GROUP BY substr(event_time,1,10) ORDER BY d" --no-verify --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -vE "UserWarning|compatib|pip install|Logged in|^$"
mkdir -p submission && printf '{"feature": "f3", "onset": "2026-03-11"}\n' > submission/answers.json && cat submission/answers.json
